mcd_chol.note: MinCovDet/EllipticEnvelope IDENTICAL C-step: log det by potrf_lower + chol_logdet and distances rowsum((Xc L^-T)^2) with L^-1 = trsm_lower(L, I), instead of partial-pivot LU + round-robin Jacobi pinvh per C-step (thousands of launches at p=220; Apple identical 225 s at 2,000 rows, race timeout at 100k). Non-PD covariance keeps -inf + pinvh. No size rule. A/B: NV + AMD min-cov-det / elliptic-envelope taxi and istella plus one non-board shape; quality: support Jaccard vs sklearn.
